179.news_title: How to Use the RGB to VGA Board to Make Retro & Commercial Installations a Breeze
179.long_description:
Restoring or upgrading retro arcade machines often means finding a reliable way to connect original RGB wiring to a modern arcade monitor. The Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board for JAMMA wiring makes this process easier by providing a compact connection between compatible RGB video signals and Arcooda LCD monitors.

Designed for retro arcade, industrial and RGB video applications, the Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board connects existing arcade machine wiring directly to a VGA monitor output. This helps installers retain original game boards, arcade parts and RGB wiring while upgrading older display technology to a compatible Arcooda arcade monitor.

The Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board is not a video upscaler. Instead, it provides a quick and practical way to connect compatible industrial and arcade RGB equipment to Arcooda LCD monitors.

The adapter supports RGB combined sync to VGA, RGB separate sync to VGA and Sync-on-Green to VGA. When used with an Arcooda monitor that supports native 15kHz and other low-resolution video signals, the board provides a straightforward solution for compatible retro arcade and JAMMA installations.

Once connected, the monitor’s Auto Picture function can be used to centre the image where required. The RGB to VGA Adapter Board also includes individual red, green and blue potentiometers, allowing installers to adjust colour intensity for a clearer and more balanced arcade display.

Unlike VGA, where RGB is 0.7 Volts, retro arcade boards or industrial boards can output anything from roughly 2 V to 5 V depending on the hardware. When the video voltages are incorrect, the colours may appear oversaturated, and the video signal may become distorted or display an out-of-frame image.
For further signal matching, the board includes DIP switch settings that add resistance to the video lines (300 Ohms, 480 Ohms and 810 Ohms). The more resistance, the softer the image. 

The Arcooda RGB to VGA Adapter Board includes a standard 5-pin R/G/B/Es/HV connector, a standard 6-pin R/G/B/H+V/V connector and a VGA connector. It also includes red, green and blue colour adjustment controls for convenient RGB picture tuning.

If no picture appears after installation, users should check the video sync connection. In some arcade machines, moving the sync wire from the VS pin position to the HS pin position may help establish an image.

Measuring 7.6 cm wide, 5.7 cm deep and 3.2 cm high, the compact board weighs 0.10 kg and can be fitted easily inside an arcade cabinet. Each package includes the RGB to VGA Adapter Board, a 5-pin RGB cable and four mounting feet.

Supplied as a new original Arcooda product, the RGB to VGA Adapter Board carries Arcooda Part Number 11399, Product Number 020136 and a 12-month warranty. It is a practical arcade parts solution for retro arcade restorations.
